programme.title: Brave Citizen [English Dub]
programme.desc: An expelled boxing champion, who now is a high-school teacher, witnesses intolerable violence and throws her first punch to build justice against it, while putting on a mask.

programme.title: Dirty Money [English Dub]
programme.desc: Two detectives in need; Myung-deuk looks after gang and takes bribes for his sick daughter; Dong-hyeok helps Myung-deuk to settle his gambling debts. One day they hear an information that Chinese gang is shipping a big amount of cash abroad and decide to steal it for themselves. But things go wrong and they're now chased both by police and Chinese gang.

programme.title: The Ugly [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Im Dong Hwan(Park Jeong-min), who never knew his mother's face, hears that there is a possibility that his mother may have been murdered. Im Dong Hwan begins to trace Jeong Yeong Hee(Shin Hyun Been)'s death with PD Kim Su Jin(Han Ji-hyun), who was filming a documentary about his father Im Yeong Gyu(Kwon Hae-hyo). They interview people who worked with Jeong Yeong Hee at a Cheonggyecheon clothing factory about 40 years ago.

programme.title: BIG BROTHER [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A soldier-turned-high school teacher uses unusual methods to reach to a class of poor students, while dealing with a greedy entrepreneur and his gang of fighters as well as the government.

programme.title: DARK NUNS [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A young boy Hee-Joon is possessed by an evil spirit. Nun Yunia tries to save him, assisted by Nun Mikaela. Priest Paul attempts medical treatment, while Priest Andrew performs an exorcism to rid Hee-Joon of the spirit.

programme.title: THE BATTLE: ROAR TO VICTORY [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Based on the Bongo-dong battle in 1920, which is remembered as the greatest victory of the Unified Korean Independence Army versus the Japanese Army.

programme.title: DETECTIVE K: SECRET OF THE LIVING DEAD [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When a series of unusual murders occurs, Detective K (KIM Myung-min) and his partner (OH Dal-soo) are once again called into action as they discover a trail of bodies with mysterious bite marks.

programme.title: Unstoppable [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ji-Soo (Song Ji-Hyo) and Dong-Chul (Don Lee) are a contented married couple. When Dong-Chul returns home one day, his wife is gone and his home is in disarray.

programme.title: SWORD MASTER [English Dub]
programme.desc: Sword Master is a martial arts action story about an elite swordsman who fakes his death to escape violence, only to be dragged back by his past. Starring Lin Gengxin, Peter Ho, Jiang Yiyan. Exhausted by endless bloodshed, a legendary master fakes his death to live in anonymity.

programme.title: LITTLE BIG SOLDIER [English Dub]
programme.desc: An old soldier kidnaps a young General of an enemy state and takes him on a long journey to collect the reward.

programme.title: MASTER Z: IP MAN LEGACY [English Dub]
programme.desc: Following his defeat by Master Ip, Cheung Tin Chi tries to make a life with his young son in Hong Kong, waiting tables at a bar that caters to expats. But it's not long before the mix of foreigners, money, and triad leaders draw him once again to the fight.

programme.title: Rebound [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In an emotional sports movie based on a true story, Yang Hyun, a former basketball player and public service worker, becomes the new coach of Busan Jungang High School's basketball team, which is in danger of disbanding. After a humiliating loss to a strong team in the national tournament, Yang Hyun recruits the players and tries to prevent the team from disbanding. As a result, a group of boys, some who don't even know what basketball is, some who have full of passion but no skill, and some who are on the verge of giving up their dreams due to slumps and injuries, come together to create a miraculous history at the 2012 National High School Basketball Championship.

programme.title: Fukushima 50 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Workers at the Fukushima Daiichi facility in Japan risk their lives and stay at the nuclear power plant to prevent total destruction after the region is devastated by an earthquake and tsunami in 2011.

programme.title: Memoir of a Murderer [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A former serial killer Byung-su gets diagnosed with Alzheimer’s. When a series of murders occur near his town, Byung-su gets worried whether the killings are his doings during his memory lapses. But then, he comes across Tae-ju and instinctively realizes that he's the serial killer. He reports this to the police, only to learn that Tae-ju is one. With his memory slipping, Byung-su must find a way to protect his daughter from Tae-ju.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ex-agent Tae-shik must confront his past when a gang kidnaps a girl he cares for, forcing him into a dangerous mission.

programme.title: Failan [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: After losing both her parents, Failan emigrates to Korea to seek her only remaining relatives. Once she reaches Korea, she finds out that her relatives have moved to Canada well over a year ago. Desperate to stay and make a living in Korea, Failan is forced to have an arranged marriage through a match-making agency. Kang Jae is an old and outdated gangster who has no respect from his peers. Short on money, Kang Jae decides to take on the arranged marriage. Having nothing more than a picture of Kang Jae, Failan spends her days dreaming and wishing that Kang Jae would come to visit her. Failan often writes to Kang Jae in sorrow about how much she misses and thinks about him, but never has the nerve to give the letters to Kang Jae. Things take a turn when Kang Jae is asked by his boss to take the fall for a murder in exchange for some money. The only hope in his worthless life is the wife he never met.

programme.title: The Villainess [English Dub]
programme.desc: An assassin seeks revenge after secrets ruin her chance at freedom, unleashing her deadly skills in a bloody rampage.

programme.title: War Of The Arrows [English Dub]
programme.desc: Korean archer Nam-Yi risks all to save his sister from Manchurian soldiers in Qing Dynasty raids. Epic action ensues.

programme.title: Secretly Greatly [English Dub]
programme.desc: A group of spies called the 5446 Corps were trained since their youth by North Korea to unify Korea. They are ambitiously dispatched to South Korea, where each disguises himself as a fool, an aspiring singer, and a high school student. One day, their mundane lives are turned upside down when a "secret and great" mission is suddenly assigned to them.

programme.title: The Great Battle [English Dub]
programme.desc: Witness the epic Siege of Ansi, where Goguryeo warriors defend against 500,000 Tang soldiers in THE GREAT BATTLE.

programme.title: My Way [English Dub]
programme.desc: Rivals Jun Shik and Tatsuo face captivity, separation, and reconciliation amidst colonization and war.

programme.title: Spiritwalker [English Dub]
programme.desc: With amnesia, a man shifts bodies every 12 hours, racing against time to regain memories and evade unknown threats.
